svg.title: Advanced Image Sensor Interface v4.0.0 system architecture
svg.desc: Layered architecture: sensor input, transport protocols, frame codec and pipeline, integrity and AES-GCM security, typed processing, depth and calibration, platform services, outputs, and verification. Protocol drivers and hardware control are simulations.
